decision.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.999) with moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.454) and 9 correlated-error groups among 19 models. The median of the full pool is robust to both the correlated-error redundancy and the moderate ranking instability, and it is statistically separated from all alternatives. The weighted approach (w1) failed catastrophically, confirming that with only 3 validation windows, fitted weights overfit noise. The median's robustness to the 11 weaker models (median error 94 vs top-8 median ~47) is the key advantage: it down-weights outliers without the variance of explicit weight estimation.
